note: Centered on Ser79's OG (catalytic nucleophile). Lys82 is deposited as a STANDARD (non-carboxylated) lysine in this structure -- no KCX present -- so the receptor was used as-deposited rather than artificially adding the carbamylation; see README 'OXA-23 vs meropenem' for the full reasoning. The real 4JF4 co-crystal ligand (component MER) is confirmed to be the ring-opened hydrolysis PRODUCT of meropenem, not the intact drug -- a fresh intact meropenem was independently fetched from PubChem and docked.
